title: AC1024 associative dependency base-field retention
scope: Preserve the typed values already decoded by the ACDBASSOCDEPENDENCY shared-prefix parser, rather than discarding them after parse. This slice does not change the DWG wire layout or enable associative DXF output.
fields: read, write, attached-to-object, and delegating-to-owning-action flags
optional dependency name, preserving absent versus present-empty
exact node handle, while retaining the historical writeDependencyHandle alias
dependency body ID, distinct from the dependency body handle

implementation.transaction: The parser reads into body/string/handle probes and publishes the retained fields only after the entire shared prefix and bounds validate. Failure resets the fields; a corrected parse on the same object succeeds.
implementation.copyAndAccounting: Copy construction and assignment retain all new fields. The associative typed-retention budget now includes the dependency name allocation.
implementation.fixturePolicy: The AC1024 parser frames are generated in memory from scratch. No DWG/DXF fixture file was added or committed.
implementation.output: No associative serializer, identity remapper, or readback was added. Strict output refusal remains active.

profiles: nondefault flag combinations and a nonempty optional name
positive, zero, and negative body IDs
generatedProof.wireCheck: An independent bit-stream walk checks class version, status, flags, order, name-presence bit, body ID, and the following body sentinel. The parser cursor also reaches the following handle sentinel after consuming exactly four dependency-prefix handles.
generatedProof.stateChecks: Copy and assignment retain the complete field set. A truncated detached name resets previously populated dependency fields and prefix state; reparsing the valid frame on the same object succeeds.

physicalSourceCheck.result: The same 335 frames are published, all audited associative graph counters remain closed with zero limits exceeded, strict export refuses with dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized, and no DXF output is created.
physicalSourceCheck.limitation: This regression check confirms the physical AC1024 reader/audit path remains stable. It does not independently report the newly retained field values from that file or qualify output semantics.

completedScopeRemovedFromPlan: Retaining the already parsed ACDBASSOCDEPENDENCY base-prefix fields in the typed model, including name presence and separate node/body references.
remainingP4Scope: Bind source associative object identities and required fields to emitted records, remap every edge, close required descendants, inspect actual output, and read it back; preserve atomic refusal and failure/retry behavior until those gates pass.
nextAction: Implement source-to-emitted identity and field binding for the audited AC1024 associative dependency/node profiles. Keep strict refusal for any required descendant that cannot yet be emitted and independently read back.
